name: Solve and analyze mathematical function problems
description: Users asked to analyze, solve, or verify specific problems involving the properties, graphs, domains, and algebraic manipulation of mathematical functions and relations. The requests covered a wide range of topics, including identifying function types, plotting equations, determining injectivity or bijectivity, and solving equations or multiple-choice questions related to function composition and continuity.
